verdicts.reason: A rewraps the headline into four bold lines that fill the portrait width and keeps the CTA close beneath it, so the hierarchy and feel of the original survive. Its only flaw is that the group sits a little low: there is about 50px below the CTA against about 170px of space at the top. B leaves the headline small and nearly edge to edge (side margins of about 35px), opens a gap of about 190px that cuts the CTA off from its copy, and leaves a dead band at the bottom, so the portrait canvas looks unused rather than redesigned.
